summary: Today's tape is mixed but risk-on in parts of crypto, with several short-term analysts leaning bullish on selected altcoins while macro commentary remains cautious on gold and broadly constructive on the dollar. Bitcoin sentiment is split, with one May 28 signal turning bearish near-term while broader market commentary still treats BTC as the anchor risk asset; equities names are not well-covered in the available results.
